name: Anisotropic Voxelization via Projection
definition: Computes view-direction-dependent probability of an event using finer resolution voxel data (level 3) to produce anisotropic voxels, solving the inaccuracy of storing single density values without view direction consideration.
summary: Anisotropic Voxelization via Projection computes view-dependent probabilities by projecting 3D voxels onto 2D planes to store directional data, avoiding simple averaging for accurate correlated media rendering.
